parameters.time: 30 h dry milling + 6 h wet milling

evidence.quote: The initial HEA powders were synthesized by MA between elemental powders (purity > 99.9%, particle size < 45 µm), and the entire process was operated utilizing a high-energy ball-milling apparatus protected by argon at 250 r/min. Thirty-hour dry milling was used to achieve a pre-solid solution between the elements, while six-hour wet milling with the control agent (ethanol) acted as the grain-refining process.
The obtained powders were consolidated by SPS at 1100 ◦C under a preset pressure of 40 MPa in vacuum.

parameters.time: 30 h dry milling + 6 h wet milling

evidence.quote: The initial HEA powders were synthesized by MA between elemental powders (purity > 99.9%, particle size < 45 µm), and the entire process was operated utilizing a high-energy ball-milling apparatus protected by argon at 250 r/min. Thirty-hour dry milling was used to achieve a pre-solid solution between the elements, while six-hour wet milling with the control agent (ethanol) acted as the grain-refining process.
The obtained powders were consolidated by SPS at 1100 ◦C under a preset pressure of 40 MPa in vacuum.
